note: After the revision by Constantino (1995); the original is in English. Soldiers and alates are described; the original states explicitly that the large-worker material consists of fragments only and is not described. Alate measurements (1 individual, mm): head length (to mandible base) 2.6, head width 2.9, fontanelle length 0.37. The species was described by Holmgren (1911); the original mentions the lectotype soldier's left mandible ... (OCR truncated).

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Because the available material is extremely limited, the original considers a reliable diagnosis impossible; the alate resembles S. wheeleri but is smaller; the soldier is larger than in S. bolivianus, with proportionally larger marginal teeth.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Compound eyes medium-sized, more than 1/4 of the head width; ocelli small; fontanelle slightly triangular and elongate. Antennae 20-segmented. Anterior corners of the pronotum moderately angular. Head capsule with many long hairs (most have been lost in the paratype alate); outer margin and surface of the pronotum hairy; abdominal tergites hairy from the middle to the posterior margin. The specimens are incompletely sclerotized.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule short, head length and width subequal; sides slightly contracted anteriorly; posterior margin of the head round or weakly trilobate. Frontal tube very short, the pore clearly visible in dorsal view. Labrum short, length and width subequal; lateral angles about right-angled; midlobe short. The number of antennal segments is given in the original.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Large worker: because the available material is in very poor condition (fragments only), the original gives no description.
